title: Slopaganda: The interaction between propaganda and generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical modeling and literature review evaluating how AI-generated propaganda (slopaganda) exploits human psychological vulnerabilities, specifically confirmation bias and negativity bias, to manipulate decision-making and memory.

Qualitative evaluation of case studies involving media ecosystems, algorithmic recommender systems, and AI-generated deepfakes that microtarget users to amplify specific ideological narratives, conspiracy theories, and political propaganda.

Examination of media framing and 'exnomination' strategies (e.g., analyzing hyper-partisan media tags like 'Black Crime') to illustrate how targeted content creates and ossifies unjustified negative conceptual generalizations about specific racial groups.
